notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.24.0
New tool: Survey Reference Gradient Correction (SRGC) — it removes gradients using a published survey image of your own exact field (NSNS narrowband, DSS2, SDSS) or your own second-scope frame, subtracting only what the real sky does not explain, so nebulosity survives instead of being eaten as gradient. Stacking Suite: frame measurements are now cached, so re-stacking a set measures nothing and adding subs measures only the new ones; ESD rejection warns you when your stack is too shallow for it to reject anything at all; drizzle warns about thin coverage and poor dither phase before the run; GPU ESD rejection is up to 5.3x faster and bit-identical. CLAHE has been rebuilt with a live preview and real comparison tools. New selectable icon packs, shipping with the Aurora pack (thanks to Tim Dicke). Plus a Blink Comparator memory guard, a Star Stretch auto-refresh preview, and a round of FITS save/load fixes. See the release notes for the full list.
